review.decision: Require producer evidence at original authority and a verified sequence after a refusal
review.notes: Seventh independent review found that a new recording generation cannot attest to pre-upgrade gaps and a stale pump time cannot order direct authorization when a refusal cursor is unavailable.

cases.description: Legacy source without collection proof and direct confirmation without a proven refusal boundary remain blocked until ordered user authority is available.
cases.setup: Isolated workspace and unchanged recording config with legacy event rows, a lost pause before upgrade, a later ordinary event, and a zero-submission receipt.
cases.action: Attempt to arm unmarked original authority before and after creating a modern coverage generation. Test a refusal after a delayed preflight, both with a readable live cursor and with no verifiable cursor. Reopen and supply prior and fresh confirmations.
cases.expected: A first generation cannot retrofit coverage. An earlier direct event cannot become a confirmation through timestamps. A later journaled source with a proven boundary or a newer workspace user instruction can authorize the same action once. Existing and unknown submissions stay reserved.
